verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview names collective scheduling as a supported event type (docs-28). The slots API can return times when two or more named users are all available, though that is documented for dynamic events rather than collective team event types (docs-38, docs-70). The team scheduling-configuration endpoint varies its response by scheduling type, but only round-robin settings are detailed (docs-35, docs-51). missing for 10: first-party docs on collective event types that show slots only when every required host is free, details on configuring required hosts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
